evidence_excerpts: In fact, there have been reported improvements in clinical symptoms and executive function in short-term training of specific mindfulness-based practices as short as three 20 min sessions (Zeidan et al., 2010) and changes in white matter connectivity after 11 h of training (Tang et al., 2010).
text: Short mindfulness interventions have been reported to improve clinical symptoms, executive function, and white matter connectivity, although dosage and quality questions remain unresolved.
